Overview.Name: S H S S Subrahmanyeswari
Overview.Goal: Improve energy, reduce inflammation, manage health conditions, and support mental wellbeing.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 3: Rice rawa upma (small portion) with vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + chicken curry (pressure cooked) + vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + fish curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Egg curry + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 3: Dal + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid skipping meals to support thyroid health and energy levels.
Keep meals anti-inflammatory by limiting fried and very spicy foods.
Eat slowly and stop before feeling too full to avoid flare-ups.
Stress and boredom trigger overeating; stick to planned meal timing.
Light movement and yoga support joint health and digestion.
Consistency with sleep, meals, and routine matters more than strict dieting.
